agenda_text:
BELMONT SHORE PARKING AND BUSINESS
  IMPROVEMENT AREA ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, OCTOBER 17, 2024
  5365 2ND STREET
  FIRE STATION 8 COMMUNITY ROOM, 9:00 AM

Matthew Peterson, Chair  David Link, Commissioner
Jann Kronick-Gath, Vice Chair  Jodi Meade, Commissioner
Deborah Castro, Commissioner  Aaron Tofani, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO PW-BSPBIAAC@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

ANNOUNCEMENTS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-55258  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Belmont Shore Parking
  and Business Improvement Area Advisory Commission meeting of Thursday,
  September 19, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-55259  Recommendation to receive and file a Long Beach Public Works financial
  report discussing revenues during the period ending September 30, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve Recommendation.

3.  24-55262  Recommendation to receive and file the Long Beach Transit Employee Bus Pass
  Program Status for September 30, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-55263  Recommendation to receive status updates on Conservation Corps of Long
  Beach’s work in the Belmont Shore area, including responses to requests for
  assistance, for September 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-55264  Recommendation to discuss increasing parking meter hours from 10:00 a.m. to
  7:00 p.m. to a new possible timeframe.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  FIRE STATION 8 COMMUNITY ROOM, 9:00 AM

6.  24-55265  Recommendation to approve a proposal from Quality Commercial Cleaning Inc.
  (dba Spectrum Facility Maintenance) to provide sidewalk and alley steam cleaning
  services through March 30, 2024, at a cost of $38,400.00, and approve a one time,
  second service weekly steam cleaning proposal at a monthly cost of $6,495.00.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Belmont Shore Parking and Business Improvement Area Advisory
Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their
comments unless extended by the Chair.

ADJOURNMENT

I, Teri A. Luce, Asst Admin Analyst, Public Works certify that the agenda was posted not less than
72 hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact PW-BSPBIAAC@longbeach.gov.
